name: Battle Axe
description:
Battle Axe is a fully weaponized TDH Hazy DIPA loaded with Citra Cryo, Citra, Citra DynaBoost, Peacharine, Riwaka, and Riwaka SubZero Hop Kief.

Expect huge aromatics of peach rings, passionfruit pulp, fresh-cut citrus, mango smoothie, and explosive southern hemi diesel. Dense hop saturation meets a pillowy body and a soft finish, delivering layer after layer of intensity. Bold, expressive, and built to leave a mark

name: Maximum Saturation
description:
A hop-forward collaboration built around a stacked lineup of Krush Cryo, Krush, Nelson Cryo, Nelson, Citra, and Tangier.

Punchy aromas of passionfruit nectar, ripe peach, white grape, candied citrus, and crushed gooseberry explode from the glass. Layers of citrus oil ride a lean, dry frame before giving way to a firm snap of resinous bitterness that keeps everything bright, focused, and insanely drinkable.

Modern hop saturation. Classic West Coast structure.

name: Intensified
description: Intensified is a DDH West Coast IPA loaded with a high-definition blend of Superdelic, NZ Cascade, Mosaic Cryo, and Mosaic - delivering an amplified spectrum of papaya, red gummies, berry medley, and leafy greens over a lean malt grist.

name: Midnight Mass
description: Imperial Stout aged in Old Fitzgerald, Elijah Craig, and 1792 barrels for 22 months.

name: Advanced Dankology
description:
Class is in session Prepare for a lesson in hop education from the strategic calculation of Mosaic, Krush, Simcoe, and Columbus Cryo hops.

Marmalade. Resin Sauce. Guava Nectar.

name: Magical Path
description:
Citra and El Dorado hops blend in harmony to take you on a murky journey.

Pineapple Sorbet. Honeydew. Tangerine Flesh.

name: Nose Deep
description:
Nelson, Riwaka, and Strata hops awaken your olfactory senses with strong notes of white grape, indica flowers, and southern hemi diesel.

For this batch we tried a yeast strain new to us at Shred that threw a bit of a wicked haze Still snappy and dry as our traditional West Coast IPA's, but with some tasty haze thiols

name: Mosaic Masterpiece
description:
A pure expression of Mosaic in every formleaf, lupulin, and liquid intensity. Mosaic Masterpiece layers 100% Mosaic hops with Mosaic T-90, Mosaic Cryo, Mosaic CO2, Mosaic 803, and Mosaic DynaBoost to push the varietal to its absolute peak.

Blueberry Fields. Resin Sauce. Papaya Flesh.

No distractions, no supporting castjust Mosaic in its most focused, expressive form.

name: Real Grass
description:
A carefully selected melange of Mosaic, Citra, and Strata hops.

Honeydew. Passionfruit. Orange Kush.

name: Shred IPA
description:
Introducing simply - Shred IPA

We carefully selected a blend of Mosaic, Citra, Simcoe, and Columbus Cryo hops to showcase intense hoppy deliciousness over a lean malt canvas. Bright tropical fruits paired with dank cannabis notes shine through on the palate for a most excellent sensory experience.

2026 World Beer Cup - Bronze Medal - Classic India Pale Ale

name: Cinco Cinco Cinco
description:
Lagered and conditioned for months. This Mexican-Style lager is a steady crusher with a supporting malt foundation of flaked maize.

2023 GABF - Silver Medal - American Cream Ale

name: Witty By Nature
description: Witty by Nature is our take on the classic Belgian-style Witbierlight, hazy, and endlessly refreshing. Brewed with wheat and kissed with sweet orange peel and coriander, it pours with a soft, pillowy body and bright citrus aroma. Gentle spice, subtle floral notes, and a crisp, dry finish make it the perfect beer for sunny days, post-ride hangs, and good company. Smooth, refreshing, and effortlessly drinkablethis is your go-to shred session in a glass.

name: Hammock Time
description: It’s summer, and that means it's Hammock Time. This Blonde Ale recalls flavors of fresh apricots, honey, and a hint of hoppiness bundled in a refreshing light ale. Perfect for those days when all you want to do is find the nearest hammock, kick off the flip flops, and chill out in the shade.

name: 1-2 Punch
description: This beer packs a hell of a punch! Of fruit that is...1-2 Punch is a hazy IPA that checks all the boxes- dynamite hops flavor from Citra, Amarillo and Mosaic, paired with Peach and Mango to punch up your palate. Crooked Lane's customer favorite!

name: Mandarin Pale Ale
style: American Pale Ale With Fresh Mandarin Juice
description: Mandarin Pale Ale features fresh-squeezed juice from Colwell Thundering Herd Mandarin Ranch. It’s crisp and satisfying with a delightful citrus aroma and dry finish. Mandarin season may only come once each year, but now you can raise a glass and celebrate year round!

name: Discover The Unicorn
description: Our love of West Coast IPA runs deep- this IPA checks all the boxes. Clear, crisp and balanced bitterness, on point with layered notes of ripe mango, melon, grapefruit and just the right amount of dank.

name: SR-16
description: SR 16 inspires with a sense of IPA adventure. A double that drinks like a single, you won’t believe the burst of Citra and Amarillo hops that resides within. One taste and you’re hooked – you’ve been warned.

name: No Hands
description: The freedom you feel when you let go and throw caution to the wind – that’s No Hands. Chock full of West Coast hop flavor, No Hands celebrates the thrill of achievement: an epic physical performance, a soaring feat of intellect... or just a great beer by your side as you flow where the river takes you.

name: Women Of Iron
description: Crooked Lane and Iron Rose FC are a badass matchup! In honor of our new partnership, we crafted this West Coast IPA with a unique blend of Chinook, Cashmere, Idaho 7 and Riwaka for a big melon and spicy nose, backed up with powerful grapefruit hop character. We are bringing this IPA to our core lineup, so we can celebrate Women of Iron all year long!

name: Throttle Therapy
description: Measured in smiles per hour!Anyone that grew up idolizing the brave men and women of racing has likely longed to test their passion on the track! we teamed up with local racing team Throttle Therapy Motorsports to celebrate those pursuing the perfect apex! drive tracks. drink slow. never mix!

name: River Daze
description: River days are on their way! Find your flavor with River Daze. For years we have partnered with Raft California to make raft trips better, and we are sealing the deal with this West Coast IPA. Brewed with Azacca, Strata & Mosaic hops. We love them and know you will too!

name: Mic Czech
description: Brewed with the fine folks at Infusion Taproom in Lincoln, CA for their 10th Anniversary, this delicious Czech-style Pilsner is a variation of our last Czech Pils, Zephyr Ridge. With the same yummy citrus and floral Saaz hops we added an addition of Tettnang hops. Which offers aromas of herbal, woodsy spiciness

name: Veedles Brau
description: There’s nothing quite like a good Kölsch. Subtle fruit character, noble German hops, light malt backbone, and crisp finish make our Kölsch-style ale exquisitely refreshing. Veedels are districts within the city of Köln, and and Veedels Bräu we transport you there for biergarten bliss.

name: Wobblor
description: German lager of the richest, most decadent character, Doppelbock was originally liquid bread, brewed to sustain the faithful while fasting. Now you can enjoy it without the hardship! Wobblor’s caramel, toffee, and rich malty flavors delight the senses and fortify against evil and adversity.

name: Blood Simple Hefeweisen with Blood Orange
description: Blood Simple is the Radler reinvented... starting with a traditional German-style Hefeweizen, we infused a decadent dose of blood orange, resulting a supremely satisfying and refreshing beer with a hue that reminds you of that sunrise after you got away with something glorious!

name: Bowman Brown Ale
description: A robust american brown ale featuring Columbus, Chinook and Willamette hops.  Generous amounts of british crystal and chocolate malts import notes of caramel, toffee and chocolate. A crushable, smooth and dark yet dry ale, a notch below a porter

name: Shmoopie- Raspberry Guava Sour- 6%
description: Whether you’re a fan of pet names or not, you’re going to fall head over heels for Shmoopie! Infused with Raspberry, Guava, Hibiscus, and LOVE, Shmoopie is here to give you a big fruity sour sweet kiss! XO

name: Pontificating Walrus- Whiskey Barrel Aged Barley wine- -12.5% ABV
description: Pontificating Walrus is much more than a silly name- this spirited barleywine is just the thing to drive off the winter chill! Aged 10 months in freshly dumped Single-Malt Whiskey barrels from treasured local distillers, St. George Spirits. Maris Otter, Belgian Candi sugar and Clover honey built the base for layered malt character and strength, resulting in an American-style Barleywine that is smooth and rich, bursting with toffee, vanilla and caramel flavors. Wax finished and foil labeled, this is just the ticket for a last minute gift, and while you’re at it, enjoy a pour on draft in our taproom. Holiday spirit ACTIVATED!

name: Cowboy Krush
description: Giddy up y’all… we have a brand new Hazy IPA you’ll be sure to crush on. Saddled with a bumper crop of El Dorado T90 and Lupomax hops, BRU-1 Cryo, along with Mosaic and Krush Cryo, Cowboy Krush is one ride you won’t want to miss!

name: Cone Zone
description: Beers with gorgeous hop flavor layered on a crushable pale lager backbone? Say less… we are huge fans of this burgeoning style, and Cone Zone just the slow down we are looking for! With Citra incognito, Mosaic and BRU-1 Cryo, and Nectraron hops bringing the rainbow of tropical, stonefruit and citrus flavors, we packed this lager so full of goodness you will feel like you unlocked a cheat code.

name: I want my MTB
description: May is Bike Month, and we can’t wait to hit the trails! We crafted I Want My MTB Pale Ale to celebrate the season. For this beer, we settled on a crushable Pilsner malt base with a hint of bitterness, and supercharged the whirlpool and dry hops with Dolcita, Huell Melon, Nectaron, and BRU-1 Cryo. This flavor would re-inflate a flat- delicate sweet nectarine, gummy candy, and the sweetest clementine… don’t sleep on this gem! Time to get outside y’all!

name: Tranquilo
description: Tranquilio is a classic super pale Mexican-Style Lager, Featuring a hint of flaked maize, Hallertau Mittelfruh, and cold, patient fermentation, this beer will help create just the kind of chill you need this spring.

name: Auburn Ulta
description: Jen Talley is a local brewing legend, whose career spans decades brewing with award-winning breweries both big and small. Having started her career at Squatter’s Pub in Salt Lake City allowed her to develop extensive expertise in low alcohol brewing, necessarily because of Utah’s alcohol laws at the time. Jen even wrote the book on session beers for the Brewers Association!We have a lot of customers who request low ABV beers, so we started planning a new seasonal called Auburn Ultra. With Jen’s incredible experience in this category, we asked her to share her knowledge with us, and she was gracious enough to do so! Jen joined us for the brew day, and it was such a pleasure to get to know her better, as well as brew with someone whose passion for the craft is so profound.Auburn Ultra is a super-pale American lager, 4% ABV, featuring Dingemans Ultra Pilsner malt, flaked rice, and low bitterness. Fermented with German lager yeast, the resulting lager is super smooth, crisp, and delicious—perfect for the hot Auburn nights ahead!

name: Briar Patch 50 year anniversary
description: When Briar Patch invited us to work with them on a special beer for their 50th anniversary celebration, we focused on ideas core to our shared mission — fresh, local ingredients of the highest quality, in a fun and delicious presentation. We selected local organic California-grown Admiral malts for a snappy wheat-focused base, fermented clean and crisp with citrus character, finally infusing local blueberries and orange juice to shape an ale that tastes like spring in a glass!

name: Freedom AF
description: Drinking what you love… what could be more American? For our great big birthday we crafted one of our perennial favorites- a robust Rye IPA! Freedom AF is generously hopped with El Dorado, Chinook, and BRU-1 Cryo, 7.76% ABV! Piney, spicy, and deeply patriotic, Freedom AF is AMERICA FOREVER!Caw!!!

name: Nectar Booster
description: When you mix a devoted home brewing hobby with a rocket scientist, you get beer that is outta this world! Matt Hall is a Placer Ultimate Brewers (PUBS) homebrewer, frequent winner of high awards, including Best of Show and a GABF Silver Medal in 2024. We love his beer, and we love to work with him because he’s got great ideas and he’s a ton of fun too. Nectar Booster is a hazy IPA utilizing some tricks we have both worked on to push the flavor envelope; cool whirlpool, advanced hop products, layered dry hop timing and Nectaron, Dolcita, and BRU-1 to blast fresh ripe stone fruit, pineapple, passionfruit flavors into orbit.
